label: M3_DCM-Harvester
info:
Backend flows for Asset Crawler + Mapper (Harvester).

MongoDB collections:
  hv_runs         – harvest run records (config, status, results, embedded logs + provenance)
  lc_assets       – local catalogue assets (written during harvest, owned by M5_DCM-LocalCatalogue)
  cr_catalogues   – catalogue registry (read-only, shared)

Operations:
  - getHarvestCatalogues (reads from cr_catalogues)
  - startHarvest (creates run, generates assets into lc_assets, stores log + provenance)
  - listHarvestRuns (find all runs)
  - getHarvestRunDetail (find one run)
  - listHarvestLogs (extract logs from runs)
  - listHarvestProvenance (extract provenance from runs)
  - pauseHarvest / resumeHarvest / cancelHarvest (update run status)

SRS Requirements covered:
  FR-ACM-01: Initiating a Harvest
  FR-ACM-02: Harvest Scope
  FR-ACM-03: Lifecycle of Imported Assets
  FR-ACM-04: Linked Assets
  FR-ACM-05: Crawling References

All responses are sent back to the Dashboard via link-out → dashboard-linkin.

label: M5_DCM-LocalCatalogue
info:
Backend flow for Local Catalogue.

MongoDB collection:
  lc_assets – normalized local catalogue asset records
             populated by Harvest (M3), managed here.

Operations:
  getLocalCatalogue  – list all lc_assets
  getLocalAssetDetail – get single asset detail
  deleteLocalAsset   – delete by uniqueId
  updateLocalAsset   – update fields by uniqueId
  getLocalProvenance – list provenance (extracted from hv_runs)
  getLocalStats      – summary stats

All responses are sent back to the Dashboard via link-out → dashboard-linkin (c48570326bcd6b3d).

const action = String(msg.type || "");
const auth = msg.auth || {};
const permissions = Array.isArray(auth.permissions) ? auth.permissions : [];
const roles = Array.isArray(auth.roles) ? auth.roles : [];
const requiredPermission = {
  "enhancePrompt": "schema.registry.update",
  "createPrompt": "schema.registry.create",
  "listPrompts": "schema.registry.read",
  "updatePromptCode": "schema.registry.update",
  "deletePrompt": "schema.registry.delete",
  "dryRunPrompt": "schema.registry.read",
  "saveTestCase": "schema.registry.create",
  "listTestCases": "schema.registry.read",
  "deleteTestCase": "schema.registry.delete",
  "updatePrompt": "schema.registry.update",

  "deleteLlmConfig": "schema.registry.delete",
  "saveProvider": "schema.registry.create",
  "deleteProvider": "schema.registry.delete",
  "reorderProvider": "schema.registry.update",
  "startBatchRetransform": "schema.registry.update",
  "cancelBatchRetransform": "schema.registry.update",
  "listLlmConfigs": "schema.registry.read",
  "listProviders": "schema.registry.read",
  "saveLocalSchema": "schema.registry.create",
  "listLocalSchemas": "schema.registry.read",
  "deleteLocalSchema": "schema.registry.delete",
  "saveMapping": "schema.registry.create",
  "listMappings": "schema.registry.read",
  "deleteMapping": "schema.registry.delete",
  "listRemoteSchemas": "schema.registry.read",
  "saveRemoteSchema": "schema.registry.create",
  "deleteRemoteSchema": "schema.registry.delete",
  "listTransformationAudit": "schema.registry.read",
  "exportTransformationAudit": "schema.registry.read",
  "updateTransformationAudit": "schema.registry.update",
  "deleteTransformationAudit": "schema.registry.delete",
  "listLocalSchemaVersions": "schema.registry.read",
  "activateLocalSchemaVersion": "schema.registry.update",
  "validateSampleAsset": "schema.registry.read",
  "listPromptVersions": "schema.registry.read",
  "getLlmUsage": "schema.registry.read",
  "getSystemSettings": "schema.registry.read",
  "setSystemSetting": "schema.registry.update",
  "saveRdfMappingConfig": "schema.registry.update",
  "testRdfMapping": "schema.registry.read",
  "executeHybridTransform": "schema.registry.read",
  "testProviderConnection": "schema.registry.read",
  "retryPromptCodeGeneration": "schema.registry.update",
  "verifyTransformationAuditChain": "schema.registry.read"
}[action] || null;
const isAdmin = auth.role === "admin" || roles.includes("admin");
const allowed = requiredPermission && (
  permissions.includes(requiredPermission) ||
  (isAdmin && permissions.includes("*"))
);
if (allowed) {
  msg._callerUsername = auth.username || "unknown";
  return [msg, null];
}
const reason = requiredPermission ? "missing_permission" : "unmapped_action";
msg.response = {
  action: action || "unknown",
  status: "error",
  ok: false,
  code: "permission_denied",
  error: "permission_denied",
  message: requiredPermission
    ? "Insufficient permissions. Required: " + requiredPermission
    : "Action is not permitted by the backend authorization policy.",
  requiredPermission
};
msg._accessDeniedAudit = {
  timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  actor: auth.username || "unknown",
  actorId: auth.userId || null,
  area: "schemaRegistry",
  action: "access.denied",
  target: action || "unknown",
  after: { requiredPermission, reason },
  result: "denied",
  source: "rbac"
};
return [null, msg];

name: ── NF-8: TAMPER-EVIDENT AUDIT HASH CHAIN ──
info:
Append-only SHA-256 hash chain over dcm_transformation_audit.

recordHash = SHA256(previousHash + canonicalPayload)
canonicalPayload = JSON of a fixed, sorted key set (chainVersion 1),
excluding recordHash and previousHash. Missing optional values are
normalised to null so verification is deterministic.

Sequence numbers and previousHash are allocated atomically via a
compare-and-set on the dcm_audit_chain_state document: the update only
applies when seq and lastHash still match what this writer observed.
A losing writer retries (bounded), so two records can never share a
sequenceNumber or previousHash.

Records written before this chain existed carry no hash and are
reported as "legacy / unverified" — never as verified.
